audit.label_basis: ARDN already dry; no moisture conversion

protocol.amendment: Before error inspection: avoid winter wheat target-issue label timing leakage
protocol.availability_caveat: Revised POWER; 7-day lag cannot guarantee historical vintage availability
protocol.availability_policy: All fit and selection labels: observed harvest plus 365 days <= target issue
protocol.candidate_families: Select ridge alpha and GBDT depth separately; baselines retained
protocol.counterfactual_crop_regret: unavailable: only the observed planted crop has a label
protocol.fit_weighting: plot rows; also report physical-site/year/crop macro error
protocol.lag_basis: Conservative modeling assumption, not observed publication dates
protocol.scope: US research plots, 2011-2015, 3 crops; no worldwide/Ukraine/SOTA claim
protocol.selection: minimum target-crop MAE in eligible 2013 labels; lexical tie break
protocol.selection_cohorts: Separate target crop and issue; fit pooled crops, select target crop only
protocol.selection_role: Retrospective development split; not a replay of validation-year issuance
protocol.sowing_usage: Eligibility and reported lead only; fixed issue date is not learned
protocol.spatial_choice_basis: Coverage chosen before errors; WI includes all 3 crops
protocol.target: dry t/ha; ARDN is already dry kg/ha, divide by 1000 only
protocol.test_exposure: Public source audited previously; diagnostic holdout, not untouched evidence
